reviews.text: Best haircut I've gotten, the fade she does is crazy good, I will definitely be going back
Ashley is the only person I've found in the area that cuts my hair just the way I like it every time!
My son is 5 and Ash did such a good job on his hair. He's got multiple cowlicks. She did his hard-part expertly and blended everything beautifully. Very thorough, with awesome attention to detail.

Ashley always does such a good job! I just give her an idea of what I'm wanting for my kids and she always blows it out of the park! The kids finally look forward to haircuts because they are getting what they want, not just a quick cut. She's very detailed with every cut!
Excellent customer service. She did a great job on my son's hair. Very engaged with him during his appointment.
I always enjoy getting my hair cut here! Ashley's the best - quick, friendly, and does a great job every time. I bring my toddlers here too, and she's amazing with them. Highly recommend!
Ashley always does an amazing job. Would recommend for anyone looking for a hair cut and/or a beard trim.
Ashley did a wonderful job on my hair cut, looked exactly how I wanted it to be.
Ashley did a fantastic job, straight line cut and fade is on point she was quick and did a good job.
Ashley has been cutting my hair for a few years now and has always been a delight to work with. Easy to contact and schedule and love the conversations!
Just moved to this Ozark Community from Kansas. Needed a barber to take care of my hair needs...Can't say enough about Ash, fantastic barber and great for conversation.
Very professional and clean! Highly recommend

Absolutely love going to visit Ash she does an amazing job with my hair and is extremely quick with it always good conversation! She's got all sorts of gear to do exactly what you need done I would recommend her to anyone you will not be disappointed!
Ashley is so funny and sweet. 10/10 barber!
The place has a lovely environment and is relaxing
